description: Create a funnel for a website. confirmed=false (default) returns a preview without writing; confirmed=true creates it.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

conversionWindowHours.description: Hours a visitor has to finish the funnel after the first step; omitted uses 24 hours. Match the journey's usual length, such as 168 or more for trial-to-paid.

filters.description: Filters on how the visitor entered the first step; later steps are not filtered.

items.description: A listed context field, properties.<key>, or trait:<key>. Trait filters take equals, not_equals, in or not_in only, compare current values as strings, and need read access to the website.

field.description: Visitor dimension or properties.<key> on the conversion event.

operator.description: How to compare the selected field with value.

value.description: Comparison text, or a list for membership matching; numeric comparisons use number text.

ignoreHistoricData.description: true counts only data from the funnel's creation date onward.

steps.description: Ordered journey steps. Each target is a page path (PAGE_VIEW; * matches any characters, e.g. /docs/*) or event name (EVENT or CUSTOM). A step's filters match properties.<key> on that step's own event.

filters.description: Predicates on properties of this step's matching event.

field.description: Visitor dimension or properties.<key> on the conversion event.

operator.description: How to compare the selected field with value.

value.description: Comparison text, or a list for membership matching; numeric comparisons use number text.

name.description: Display label identifying this step in funnel reports.

target.description: Page path for PAGE_VIEW, with * wildcards, or event name for EVENT and CUSTOM.

type.description: Whether this step matches a page view or a named event.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: create_funnel

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. funnel contains its name, ordered steps, filters, historical-data policy and conversionWindowHours; saved results also include ID, activation and update time; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Create funnel
